CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

February 27, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra
  City Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

Staff Present:
ERIC D. MARTINEZ

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: February 13, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the February 13, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Herandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1500 Edgewood Drive

  •  Request: This is an application for an exterior and interior remodel, window
  changes, roof changes to the existing house and detach garage, and new open
  patio along the side yard.

  1
   •  Applicant: Maddy and Ariana Patroske
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  1121 South Granada Avenue

  •  Request: This is an application for exterior renovations, window replacements,
  and re-roofing of an existing single-family house.
  •  Applicant: Jason Sun
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed
  project is approved with the following conditions of approval:
  1) The project shall either refurbish or replace the existing window sill trim to
  match the existing, both in size and color.
  2) The applicant shall revise elevation legend keynote #6, and resubmit for City
  Architect to review and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with
  conditions as follows:
  1) The project shall either refurbish or replace the existing window sill trim to
  match the existing, both in size and color.
  2) The applicant shall revise elevation legend keynote #6, and resubmit for City
  Architect to review and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  1800 West Valley Boulevard

  •  Request: This is an application for new building signage, directional signage, and
  free-standing signs on a newly proposed 3,277 SF 1-story commercial building
  with drive thru and onsite parking, for business known as “Starbucks”.
  •  Applicant: Diana Nagel
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

  2
 MOTION:
  • Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with
  conditions as follows:
  1) The applicant shall provide two (2) alterative designs for the free-standing
  pole sign #P with one design study showing the words ‘Starbucks’ as
  opposed to the logo.
  2) The applicant shall present these design alternatives for City Architect to
  review and select one for approval.
  • The second was by Board member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 5:  1924 – 1928 West Valley Boulevard

  •  Request: This is an application a Master Sign Program for tenants’ signage on an
  existing 1-story commercial building with seven (7) tenant spaces / units located
  at the corner of West Valley Boulevard and South Raymond Avenue.
  •  Applicant: Lavendar Fung
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:
  • Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application without
  conditions.
  • The second was by Board member Daninger.
  • The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  • For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 6:  1815 South Meridian Avenue

  •  Request: This is an application for a 1,614 SF 1- and 2-story addition to an existing
  1,465 SF 1-story single-family house with an expansion to the existing 2-car
  garage at street level, where the project is situated into the hillside.
  •  Recommended Action: CONTINUANCE - The proposed project is recommended
  to be continued to further study the following:
  1) The study shall include a design alternative that revises the front entry roof
  form to be consistent with the Ranch architectural style, such as providing a
  hipped roof form that simplifies the roof shape and provides a cascade of
  planes down towards the entry.
  2) The study shall include a design alternative that revises the 2nd floor windows,
  such as size and type, in response to the re-configuration of the front entry roof
  form as described in Condition #1.

  3
   3) The study shall include a design alternative that removes curved roof parapet
  and extends the eave of the hipped roof over the curved bay window, creating
  a continuous eave line across the front elevation, to maintain the Dutch
  Colonial impression while enhancing to the horizontal lines of the Ranch style.
  This can potentially be accomplished by framing the eaves with a shallower
  pitch, to maintain minimum headroom clearance at the exterior stairs.
  4) The applicant shall provide this study to the City Architect for evaluation prior
  to the next hearing for this project.

MOTION:
  • Board member Hernandez makes a motion to Continue the application with
  conditions as follows:
  1) The applicate shall provide a design alternative that revises the front entry
  roof form to be consistent with the proposed architectural style, such as
  providing a hipped roof form that simplifies the roof shape and provides a
  cascade of planes down towards the entry.
  2) The applicant shall provide a design alternative that revises the 2nd floor
  windows, such as size and type, in response to the re-configuration of the
  front entry roof form as described in Condition #1.
  3) The applicant shall provide a design alternative that addresses the curved
  roof parapet to maintain the Dutch Colonial impression.
  4) The applicant shall revise the door schedule and materials to accurately
  depict the proposed door style, color, and material.
  5) The applicant shall provide a study for an alternative front door design that
  introduces the use of glass either by integrating it into the door or providing
  sidelites.
  6) The applicant shall study the front porch column color and/or material that
  presents a non-wood finish.
  7) The applicant may follow up with the Planning Department on the
  requirements for front yard railing, such as setbacks, height, and placement.
  8) The applicant shall provide the design alternatives and studies for City
  Architect to review and approve prior to the next hearing for this project.

  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

E. ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:24 P.M. to March
  12, 2024.

MOTION:

  •  Board Member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:24 P.M.
  •  The second was by Udani.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  4
   Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Tsai, Daninger, Ng
  Noes:  None
